Since opening in Plano, Pawsh Wash has been the go-to grooming destination for dog parents who demand excellence. Our certified groomers use gentle handling techniques and premium products to keep your pup looking and feeling their best. We believe every dog deserves a spa day.

Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions? We've got answers.

How long does an appointment take?

Appointment length varies by service — a quick nail trim takes about 15–20 minutes, while a full groom can range from 1 to 3 hours depending on your dog's size, coat type, and temperament. We'll give you a precise time estimate when you book.

What are your vaccination requirements?

For the safety and well-being of all our furry guests, we require current rabies and DHPP (distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus, parainfluenza) vaccines. Please bring proof of vaccination records to your first appointment.

Can I stay during the groom?

We recommend dropping off your pup so they can relax without distraction. We'll text you updates and photos throughout the appointment!

What if my dog has sensitive skin?

We use hypoallergenic, gentle products and can work with your vet on special shampoos. Please let us know about any allergies or skin conditions when booking so we can prepare accordingly.

Do you offer same-day appointments?

We do our best to accommodate same-day requests, especially for nail trims. Call us at (469) 555-0147 to check availability.

What's your cancellation policy?

We ask for 24-hour notice for cancellations. Late cancellations may incur a 50% service fee.
